fields.issue: The two filed RMS values use nu=.30 for angular width, while mechanics inherit nu=.33. More substantially, amplitude is inverted from a lambda_I=1 fit and then the RMS width is set to 2.625; that is not a single defect with a demonstrated knockdown/amplitude/RMS tuple.
fields.implication: 45.819441 mm amplitude reproduces. With width nu=.33, the same lambda_I=1 Gaussian gives 0.654416 mm whole-sphere RMS; merely changing width gives 1.717842 mm, not a validated tolerance at the same knockdown. The filed 1.708852 mm is reproduced with width nu=.30.
fields.source: Baizhikova et al., doi:10.1016/j.jmps.2025.106468, Eq.2–3 and section 4.1; MAINLINE-015
fields.needed_evidence: State width and nu together; calculate a coupled defect response for the sandwich, including seams and multiple defects.
